resources.string: E-mail the author; a safe report is attached
Describe what happened or what you suggest:
No e-mail app found. The address %1$s was copied.

Videos that the site marks as adults only are not downloaded and the “I am 18” confirmation is not offered. The PIN (4–8 digits) is optional: if set, turning protection off asks for it. This prevents accidental downloads; it is not a lock that cannot be bypassed.
The PIN must have 4 to 8 digits.
App language and English, as a separate file next to the video (in Downloads)
On: only for the next video, then it switches off

The quality chosen in advance on the quality screen and used for quick downloads. Best takes the highest quality the site offers; 1080p, 720p or 480p take at most that size, which saves data and space. You can still choose a different quality for each video.

Downloads: files go to Download/Video Download. Gallery and Music: videos go to Movies/Video Download (visible in the Gallery) and audio to Music/Video Download (visible in music apps). Files already downloaded stay where they are.

When you share a link from another app (Share → Video Download), the download starts right away in the default quality and you stay in that app. Playlists, videos marked 18+ and parental control still open the screen so you can decide.

The next video you download is saved without sound (picture only). It applies to one video only and then switches off by itself. Audio downloads (MP3/M4A) do not use it up. On the quality screen you can still untick it for that video.

Sign in to %1$s only if you want to download videos that it shows to signed-in users. You sign in on the site’s own page inside this app; your password never reaches us. The sign-in stays on this phone and is sent only to %1$s. Tap again to sign out.
On: the app uses the color palette of your phone (Android 12 and later). Off: the app’s own blue colors. Light and dark theme always follow the phone.
Opens the Android settings where you choose the app’s language (English, Bosnian, Serbian, Croatian, German, Spanish or French), independently of the phone’s language.

The app checks once a day whether a new version is out and shows a notice at the top. This button checks right away. The update is checked against its fingerprint (SHA-256) and Android always asks you before installing it.
Version of the app and of yt-dlp, the part that reads websites (it updates itself in the background). Tap to see what is new in the latest versions.
How many videos you have downloaded and which achievements you have earned. Everything is counted only on this phone and is never sent anywhere.
Opens your e-mail app with a message to the author (abnpsdev@gmail.com) and a short technical report (version and recent errors). You can read and change everything before sending.
Opens the Video Download server on Discord: questions, help and news in 5 languages. You need a Discord account for it.
Opens the share menu with the app itself (APK file) and a short message, so you can send it via WhatsApp, Viber or Quick Share. Nothing is sent until you choose a contact.
Voluntary contribution via PayPal. It unlocks nothing: the app is free and the same for everyone. Thank you!
Voluntary contribution by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay on a secure Stripe page. It unlocks nothing: the app stays free for everyone.
Voluntary contribution through Ko-fi, by card, without a PayPal account. It unlocks nothing.
Opens the terms of use on the website: what the app may be used for (your own videos, videos you have the author’s permission for and free licenses).
Opens the privacy policy on the website: no account, no ads, no tracking, and your links never reach us.
Licenses of the open-source parts the app uses (yt-dlp, Python, Chaquopy, icons…).
Here you see what is downloading and what has finished. Press and hold a button to see what it does.
Downloads that are running or waiting. Interrupted downloads stay here so you can try again.
Finished and failed downloads. The filters show only videos, only audio or only what failed.
Show only downloads that failed: you can try again or copy the link
Stops this download and removes its temporary files
Starts the same download again with the same settings

Copies the video’s link so you can paste it somewhere else
